title: Cardinality
description: How many members a set has. Von Neumann built every number from nothing: zero is the empty set, one is the set holding it. Unlocks Zero and Unity.

puzzle.goal: A set has n members. A relation on it says, for every ordered pair of members, whether the pair is related. Write how many different relations there are.
puzzle.name: Counting relations
puzzle.method: There are n² ordered pairs, and each is either in the relation or not: two choices, n² times over (a subset of the pairs, so the size of a power set).
